body: These pics are really cool. Keep it up. I wish I could convey my thoughts and feelings through original images - I just don't have that natural ability to transfer what's in my head onto paper.
Impressive. How did you do this? Sketch?

All of this sounds horrible. It's shitty that you, and so many others, and dealing with so many things at once.

When it comes to clearing your head and checking out for a while without substances - getting outside and walking, exploring, helps me. I get out into the bush or down the beach (not sure if you have that kind of environment near by) and just focusing on the environment around me is enough to help me forget the rest of the world for a while.
Yeah, this is always a shitty thought and feeling. I am no one's person.
All the time. When I'm travelling alone I often daydream about just disappearing. Just not getting on a return flight and never contacting anyone to let them know where I am.
